column1: # The Mac-only regions of DiabloII_macho 1.14d, cut into units. Read by coverage.ts.
# lo, hi       the unit's address range, [lo, hi), the clean program's addresses (imagebase 0x1000)
# kind         fixed: every function in the unit gets `file`
#              anchors: a function's file is its own __FILE__ literal, else the file of the nearest anchored
#                function before and after it in the unit when both agree, else "<before>|<after>";
#                `file` is the folder used where no anchor is on one side
#              override: one function (lo only) keeps its unit for bracketing but takes this class and file
# class        blizzard-mac | third-party | shared. In a shared unit a function is shared when it has a
#              Windows twin, shared-unpaired when the pairer found it a body candidate on Windows, and
#              blizzard-mac (a D2_OS_MAC addition to a shared file) when it found none
# file         the original path below Diablo2/Source (Mac folder names with their spaces); "?" for a file
# redivivus    where the source lives in this repo when that is not the original path with spaces dropped
#              (a unit whose original file name is unknown); "-" for code that is not reconstructed here
# Sources: the binary's __FILE__ literals (mac-seam notes, 2026-11-27), Source/StormMac/README.md (the
# Win32 Mac units pinned against the PPC Storm 1.10 beta), docs/analysis/mac-only-inventory.md,
# stormmac-refine.md ("What has no PPC counterpart") and the clean program's names.
